description: This file defines the TemplateField class used for managing dynamic field templates within SuiteCRM, including HTML rendering, database schema generation, and metadata management.

classes.name: TemplateField
classes.description: Represents a template for dynamic fields, providing methods for rendering HTML, managing database schema, and handling metadata.

methods.name: get_html
methods.description: Returns the HTML representation of the field depending on the current view.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple properties of the TemplateField from an array.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for edit view (not implemented).

methods.name: get_html_list
methods.description: Returns HTML for list view.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns HTML for detail view (not implemented).

methods.name: get_html_search
methods.description: Returns HTML for search view.

methods.name: get_html_label
methods.description: Generates label HTML, including required indicator and sorting links.

methods.name: get_xtpl
methods.description: Returns the XTPL representation depending on the current view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Returns XTPL for edit view (not implemented).

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns XTPL for list view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns XTPL for detail view (not implemented).

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Returns XTPL for search view.

methods.name: is_required
methods.description: Checks if the field is required.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Returns the database column type for this field.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns SQL snippet for default value configuration.

methods.name: get_db_required
methods.description: Returns SQL snippet for null/not null constraint.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to add the column in ALTER TABLE statement.

methods.name: get_db_delete_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop the column in ALTER TABLE statement.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to modify the column in ALTER TABLE statement.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns an array defining the field's metadata for bean definition.

methods.name: populateFromRow
methods.description: Populates object properties from a database row.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates object properties from the HTTP request ($_REQUEST).

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field to the module builder and updates search fields if needed.
